title: Unlocking Spatial Grounding in Flow-Matching Models via SNR Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.29581v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite the success of foundation models in image synthesis, achieving fine-grained spatial control remains a significant challenge, typically requiring auxiliary structural adapters or complex inference-time steering. While modern vision-language (VLM) text encoders possess the latent capacity to represent spatial coordinates, generative models often fail to leverage this information. We demonstrate that the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) distribution is a critical determinant of spatial grounding in flow-matching models. Using a novel synthetic benchmark of geometric primitives, we isolate structural mechanics from textural complexity inherent in natural imagery and introduce a rigorous color-aware layout metric to quantify spatial fidelity. We show that training on a centered SNR distribution results in poor layout adherence (25.9%). Instead, we identify high-noise regimes as a "critical learning phase" for spatial grounding. Shifting

translated_title: 通过信噪比调节解锁流匹配模型中的空间接地能力
translated_abstract: 尽管基础模型在图像合成领域取得了成功，但实现细粒度的空间控制仍然是一个重大挑战，这通常需要辅助的结构适配器或复杂的推理时引导。虽然现代视觉-语言模型（VLM）文本编码器具备表示空间坐标的潜在能力，但生成模型往往未能利用这些信息。我们证明，信噪比（SNR）分布是流匹配模型中空间接地的关键决定因素。借助一种新颖的几何基元合成基准，我们将结构机制与自然图像固有的纹理复杂性分离开来，并引入一种严格的颜色感知布局度量来量化空间保真度。我们表明，在居中的SNR分布上进行训练会导致较差的布局遵从性（25.9%）。相反，我们发现高噪声区间是空间接地的“关键学习阶段”。将……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现信噪比（SNR）分布是流匹配模型空间接地能力的关键决定因素，指出高噪声区间是空间学习的“关键学习阶段”，通过调节SNR训练分布即可显著提升模型对空间布局的精细控制，而无需额外的结构适配器或复杂的推理时引导。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the SNR distribution is a critical determinant of spatial grounding in flow-matching models, and that shifting training toward high-noise regimes—identified as a "critical learning phase"—unlocks fine-grained spatial control without auxiliary structural adapters or complex inference-time steering.
